notes.title: Hardware panel
notes.text:
# Hardware panel

Show CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM for Home PC and Work PC in one readable panel.

Working overview for Hardware panel. Mira Tallow is following the implementation with Orin Valecrest.

The hardware panel uses one card per PC. CPU and GPU bars share a percentage scale; RAM and VRAM also show used and available capacity.

A two-second sample interval keeps the sparkline readable. Retain the last sixty samples and pause sampling when the panel is hidden.

Related: [[Mira Tallow]], [[Orin Valecrest]], [[Hardware panel: test report]], [[Hardware panel: data contract]], [[Claude working notes]], [[Codex working notes]].

The hardware panel review uses the same units on Home PC and Work PC.

notes.title: Glucose pattern notebook
notes.text:
# Glucose pattern notebook

Explain how a fictional glucose day becomes a useful pattern review.

Working overview for Glucose pattern notebook. Selka Fenrow is following the implementation with Tovin Ashmere.

The glucose examples are invented teaching data. Five-minute readings cover a complete day and each observation links to its meal or overnight window.

Breakfast has a repeating early rise across four fictional weekdays. The report compares similar meals before offering a pattern to review.
